name: pointer
blurb: Custom animated cursor appears on hover, displaying child content at pointer position.
description: Renders a custom animated cursor that tracks mouse position over the parent container and displays child content at the pointer location.
use_when: Interactive zones or hover areas where a custom cursor provides visual feedback and enhanced engagement.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or contexts where cursor replacement is not appropriate.
a11y: Custom cursor is visual only; no semantic content or keyboard interaction.
